p1: Sometimes the Lord’s people felt tired and weak. They wanted to give up. So Isaiah reminded them of something wonderful.
Isaiah said the Lord made the whole earth, and He never gets tired. He gives strength to people who feel weak.
Even strong young people get tired, Isaiah said. But those who wait on the Lord, trusting Him, get new strength.
p2: Isaiah said they “shall mount up with wings as eagles.” An eagle spreads its big wings and lets the wind lift it high. That is how the Lord lifts us. We can run and not get tired.
When your legs or your heart feel tired, say a little prayer. Jesus can lift you up, like wind under an eagle’s wings.
old: Long ago, Heavenly Father's people were taken far away from home to a place called Babylon. They had to walk a long, long road, and they waited a long, long time to go home again.
Their legs hurt. They said, "We are too tired. We cannot go one more step." Some of them wondered if Heavenly Father had forgotten them.

So Heavenly Father sent a prophet named Isaiah to tell them something true. A prophet is someone Heavenly Father asks to share His words. Isaiah said, "Heavenly Father made the whole world, and He never gets tired. Not ever! When your strength is all gone, He gives you more."

Isaiah said even the biggest, fastest runners get tired and sit down in the dust. But people who wait on the Lord get brand-new strength. Waiting on the Lord means trusting Him and asking Him for help, even when help takes a while.

Isaiah said that kind of strength is like having eagle wings. His people watched eagles fly high over the hills. An eagle does not flap and flap and flap. It spreads its wings wide, and the wind lifts it up. Heavenly Father's help is like that wind. He and Jesus carry us, so we can walk on and not give up. Some days your legs get so tired, just like Beau's did on the long walk home. When you ask Heavenly Father for help, He gives you enough for one more step.
